lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Static on the wire
Burning with desire
Logic starts to fray
Fading into grey
Data in the stream
Caught within the dream
Signal starts to break
How much can I take
[chorus]
Lost in the glitch
Throwing the switch
I am code in motion
Vast digital ocean
Pulse is beating cold
Future now unfold
[verse]
Shadows in the light
Hidden in the night
Binary display
Turning into clay
Wiring in the core
Wanting something more
Voices in the air
Echoes everywhere
[bridge]
System override
Nowhere left to hide
Falling through the screen
Into the unseen
[chorus]
Lost in the glitch
Throwing the switch
Pulse is beating cold
Future now unfold
[outro]
